reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 969 for 4845 receivers. The independent set gives lower 969, and the linear code over F_2 with c = 1 gives upper 969; independent_set, code_fits, factorization and decoding all passed. Wall time was 31.589 s, of which 29.323 s was LLM time and only 2.266 s compute, with 4 LLM calls and 1 code tried. Baselines: CP-SAT alpha found 969 but did not prove it (145.05 s); CP-SAT cover timed out; fractional cover gave 4841.0, unproven; F2 min-rank SAT reached only 968 (5.11 s). The earlier kushagra_agent also proved 969/969 in 18.66 s, faster than this agent's 31.589 s. Nothing suspicious.
